desc: Derive piecewise edge-contribution probabilities for u<v: i<u -> 2(i-1)/(i(i+1)); i=u -> (u-1)/u; u<i<v -> 1/i; i=v -> 1; i>v -> 0; edge i=1 nonexistent.
Cross-check formula against samples 1 and 2 (2, 3 and 100) and confirm joint ancestor probability 2/(i(i+1)).
Implement O(N+Q) algorithm: inverses, factorial (N-1)!, prefix sums S1, S2, O(1) per query, print answers; test on samples 1-3 and edge cases (N=2, u=1, v=N).
Report the sample-test verdict (PASS/FAIL) with outputs for all three samples.
